# Vendored: kfxlib (KFX Input calibre plugin)

`KFX Input.zip` is the **KFX Input** calibre plugin by **John Howell (jhowell)**,
version **2.25.0**, distributed under the **GNU GPL v3**. This project imports its
`kfxlib` package directly from the zip to decode KFX books; nothing in it is
modified.

- Upstream: <https://www.mobileread.com/forums/showthread.php?t=291290>
- SHA-256: `a4d95a13d987c9939b2755285663670987aac2afa10993f2ecf24e7526230877`

The zip contains the plugin's complete source. To use a different copy, point
the `KHR_KFXLIB` environment variable at it.
